text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The fiery spirit of justice burns within 
me! Take this, my ultimate move: "Pegasus 
Paaaanch"!

text_block_list.name: Villainous Monster
text_block_list.text: Kieee! You gooooot meee...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, just as planned! Trainer... or 
should I say, Commander!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm taking on a VR game where 
you defeat evil monsters. The rule is to 
compete over how many monsters you can 
take down in the end, but――"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Still at the starting line? Then 
this match is my win!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mumu...! No, a hero never loses! I'll 
catch up to you in no time!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Pegasus Hurricaaane"!! "Pegasus 
Tornadooo"!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I see it! That back is, 
Sweep's――...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's with this guy...?! My magic isn't 
working at all...!

text_block_list.name: Spider Monster
text_block_list.text:
No one can escape from yours truly! Just 
be good and become my prey right here~~!
choice_data_list:
That monster... apparently it has magic 
resistance...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh no! We have to help—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't need it, I don't need it! I don't 
need any hero's heeeelp!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"This is a competition, you know?! So 
you'd better hurry up and—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...No way in hell!!!! Like I'd ever 
abandon you!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's not just because I'm a hero!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to help you as your cherished 
"rival"!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I still refuse! ...Like I'd let you 
keep bailing me out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Biko, I'll cast a spell on you! It's an 
enhancement spell that borrows an 
Umamusume's power to boost your strength!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sweep...! Thank you!! All riiiight...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Commander! Requesting orders on whose 
power we should enlist!"
choice_data_list: With Shinko Windy's 'energy' as my weapon!

We'll turn this around in one shot with 
Hishi Akebono's 'Power'!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well then, here I go! —"Lantana Fusion"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“Now, why don't we begin our delightful 
experiment!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Channeling the bonds with my rival into 
strength! Take this, special move! Union 
Attack!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Pegasus Madness Attaaack"!!

text_block_list.name: Spider Monster
text_block_list.text: GGYAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Look at you, all battered and 
bruised. Come over here. I'll cast some 
healing magic on you."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Thanks, Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Hmph! Now we're even, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a short rest, Biko Pegasus and the 
others resumed their match!

text_block_list.name: Spider Monster
text_block_list.text: Guh-geeeh!? Is that all you've got...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Then it's time for another special move!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do it as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Sweep
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it took quite a bit of time, Biko 
Pegasus and the others managed to defeat 
their formidable foe. Afterward, they 
resumed their contest.
